description:
### WARP Patches (v1.0.2)

* **App label: 1.1.1.1**: Writes the literal "1.1.1.1" into the manifest instead of the raw `@string/four_ones` reference, so Morphe Manager and package parsers show the app name correctly
* **Spoof WARP+ Unlimited UI**: Forces the account type to WARP+ UNLIMITED so the app displays the WARP+ Unlimited interface. This is a client-side UI change only; the real WARP+ entitlement is issued and enforced by Cloudflare's servers
* **Working APK download link**: 6.38.9 is the recommended version because Morphe Manager resolves it directly to APKMirror
* **6.38.11 support**: Still patchable as an experimental target (the Manager download API points 6.38.11 at a dead Uptodown page)

Supports 1.1.1.1 + WARP: Safer Internet v6.38.9 (recommended) and v6.38.11 (experimental), APKM.
